description: This file defines the `OFBizHomeLocationResolver` class, which implements `LocationResolver`. It provides functionality to resolve a location string to a URL by prepending the OFBiz home directory specified via a system property and handling URI construction.

classes.name: OFBizHomeLocationResolver
classes.description: A location resolver that constructs file URLs based on the OFBiz home directory environment variable.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a location string into a URL, using the 'ofbiz.home' system property as the base directory.
